flags.enable: Set env OPENCLAW_DCS_CONTEXT_VIEW_TOOLS=1 (or OPENCLAW_DCS_CONTEXT_TOOLS=1) and restart gateway/runtime.
flags.rollback: Unset env or set to 0/false and restart. View tools leave the default catalog.
flags.riskNote: A/B avgReduction still below 5x gate; keep default-off until C1 graduation + product approval.

flags.enable: Alias of OPENCLAW_DCS_CONTEXT_VIEW_TOOLS; set =1 only when intentionally enabling view tools.
flags.rollback: Unset or set to 0/false and restart.
flags.riskNote: Alias only; do not treat as a separate graduation path.

flags.enable: Set openclaw config runtime.coding.staleWriteGuard.enabled=true (or override in process).
flags.rollback: Set enabled=false or remove leaf; process restart if config is file-backed.
flags.riskNote: Can block full-file writes that look stale; monitor coding.write.falseBlockRate.

flags.enable: Already on by default for undo_write snapshots. Leave enabled unless diagnosing journal I/O.
flags.rollback: Set runtime.coding.writeJournal.enabled=false only as temporary kill-switch (loses undo snapshots).
flags.riskNote: Read-only ops note in P0 packaging; not an enhancement to flip for demos.

flags.enable: Set runtime.coding.worktree.backend=git OR createWorktreeService({ backend: "git" }). Requires isolation=worktree on the request/plan.
flags.rollback: Set backend=inprocess. Isolation request default remains shared.
flags.riskNote: Not C4-H hardened; Windows path/lock/install residuals remain. Do not change isolation default.

flags.enable: Pass isolation: "worktree" on orchestrator request/plan (or worker) when multi-worker writes need isolation.
flags.rollback: Omit isolation or set "shared". Unknown values normalize to shared.
flags.riskNote: normalizeIsolationMode defaults shared; production default must stay shared until C4-H + approval.

flags.rollback: enabled=false. Shared write path is unperturbed when off.
flags.riskNote: Multi-process WAL not production-hardened (C5-H residual). Prefer mode=memory until C5-H.

flags.enable: runtime.coding.symbolLease.mode=wal only after multi-process WAL acceptance.
flags.riskNote: wal is experimental until C5-H multiProcessWalHardened=true.

flags.enable: Call applyPatchProposalsSerial() / recommendIsolationMode({...}). Do NOT set runtime.coding.patchFlow.default=true without C5-H + approval.
flags.rollback: Stop calling patch-flow APIs; keep patchFlow.default=false.
flags.riskNote: recommendIsolationMode is advisory only; no auto-switch of production isolation.

flags.enable: Import and call applyContextLadder from context-ladder.ts with an explicit tokenBudget. Assembler production path does not auto-ladder.
flags.rollback: Stop calling applyContextLadder; leave assembler defaults unchanged.
flags.riskNote: 64K evidence is synthetic until C6-H live corpus. L4 embedding remains deferred.

flags.enable: runtime.coding.routingMemo.shadow=true OR recordRoutingMemoShadow({ enabled: true }). Dual-write only; no prompt injection cutover.
flags.rollback: shadow=false. Does not alter default COMPASS/role-memory/routing injection.
flags.riskNote: cutoverAllowed stays false until C7-H + written product approval.
Shadow journal only; experienceHitRate still fixture-level. No default knowledge injection.
